failure_summary.description: The agents failed to resolve the requested referent from the clue: one conflated loosely connected facility and location details, while the other repeated the clue instead of naming the president identified by its dates.

patch.reasoning: The existing skill already directs agents to identify the requested referent, return the missing value for clue-like prompts, and require direct support for all parts of a candidate. Both failures disregard those rules, so adding overlapping instructions is not warranted.
